sources.title: Boyd and Vandenberghe Convex Optimization slides
sources.checked: Actual PDF text read: pages22–27 sets and combinations, page45 convex functions, pages52–54 first/second-order tests, page57 Jensen. Treat differentiability shorthand using full differentiability as explicitly defined in this course; mere coordinate partials are not sufficient.

sources.title: Bertsekas Convex Analysis and Optimization slides
sources.checked: Actual PDF pages40–42 read: local/global optimality, nonempty closed convex projection existence/uniqueness, variational inequality and nonexpansiveness; full proof outline read.

sources.title: NumPy 2.3 clip
sources.checked: Official NumPy 2.3 page re-read 2026-10-04: clipping behavior, broadcasted bounds, and absent bound-order validation. Executed direct np.clip reversed-bound example and verified wrapper rejects it.

sources.title: NumPy 2.3 lstsq
sources.checked: Official NumPy 2.3 page re-read 2026-10-04: multiple minimizers return smallest 2-norm solution; rcond controls numerical rank; underdetermined systems can return empty residual arrays. Directly observed an empty residual array for the 2x3 example and independently checked A@p-b.

retrieval_limits: Full Boyd textbook and full Bertsekas textbook could not be opened reliably; no claim of full-book reading. Author-hosted lecture PDFs were successfully retrieved and relevant sections read.
independent_authorship: Original lecture reasoning, Chinese exposition, synthetic data, 12 figures, lab, answers, and code. Author-hosted source material is used to check theorem assumptions, not copied as a book.
mathematical_conditions_checked: Convex domain and full differentiability for the first-order criterion
C2 and Hessian PSD throughout an open convex domain for the second-order criterion
Finite Jensen induction covers zero and unit weights; no expectation-form claim
Strict convexity gives at most one minimizer, not existence
Finite-dimensional compactness and continuous minimum theorem explicitly used for projection existence
Projection theorem requires nonempty closed convex set
Single sequential projections are not asserted to equal intersection projection
KKT and duality deferred to unit065
